fund_dispersion.method: Per-fund implied marks (value / principal x 100) from N-PORT holdings at each CUSIP's latest report period, against the principal-weighted aggregate mark.
fund_dispersion.limits: Dispersion measures disagreement between funds at one period end. It does not measure staleness against the tape: no tape exists at the July period end.

gap_convergence.method: Gap = last TRACE trade price minus latest fund mark. The implied adjustment is the move the next mark must make to reach the current tape, if the tape holds.
gap_convergence.limits: Convergence speed is first measurable when the 2026-10-31 marks are filed (about 60 days after period end). This section measures the stock of unadjusted gap, not yet its decay rate.

issuer_curves.method: Spread to Treasury (bp) against years to maturity, one point per bond. Price basis is the last TRACE trade where one exists, else the latest fund mark; the basis is stated per point. Yield is yield-to-worst on the page convention.
issuer_curves.limits: Mark-based points are period-end valuations, not trades; a curve that mixes bases is an approximation and is labelled as such per point.

twin_basis.method: Last print of the Rule 144A line minus last print of the registered line of the same security.
twin_basis.limits: The two lines rarely print on the same day; the basis mixes the liquidity premium with timing differences. Both print dates are stated.

liquidity.method: Stored TRACE trades per watched bond over the collection window, with the trailing 7-day count and days since the last trade, both measured at the tape end date.
liquidity.limits: The window starts 2026-10-07 and lengthens daily. Absence of trades is evidence about liquidity, not about value.

event_study.method: For each material filing (8-K, 10-Q, 10-K, 6-K, S-1, 424B) by a watched issuer inside the tape window: the issuer's nearest-trading bond, its last print before the filing date and its first print on or after it.
event_study.limits: Coverage is limited to issuers whose CIK is recorded in the forensic dataset and whose name matches the registry. The window is short and lengthens daily.

alert_backtest.method: The standing flag rule applied to history. Marks leg: a mark below 90 or a fall of 5+ points in one period fires; the knowledge date is the period end plus 60 days (the N-PORT filing lag). Tape leg: the first stored trade below 90. Reference date: 2026-10-14, the first press report of the CoreWeave slide.
alert_backtest.limits: The marks rule is an adaptation: the live rule uses trade-versus-mark gaps, which history cannot supply before the tape begins. The 60-day lag is the standard N-PORT deadline, not a measured per-fund lag.
